releases.name: opencode-kimi-code-statusline 1.1.1
releases.body:
### Changed

- Correct the README's plan, examples, and `Kimi —` troubleshooting to match the per-plan quota, name the config files that take the `language` option, note that `cli.json` takes precedence, and link the changelog.
- Re-record the README demo animation.

### Fixed

- Show the quota of the plan the session runs on when both the global and the China plan are connected.
- Keep showing one plan's quota when the other plan's host fails or times out.

<details>
<summary>简体中文</summary>

### 变更

- 修正 README 中的套餐说明、示例和 `Kimi —` 疑难排查，使其与按套餐显示配额一致，写明 `language` 选项所在的配置文件，说明 `cli.json` 中的设置优先，并链接到变更日志。
- 重新录制 README 演示动画。

### 修复

- 同时连接国际版和国内版套餐时，显示当前会话所用套餐的配额。
- 一个套餐的服务器出错或超时时，仍显示另一个套餐的配额。

</details>

**Changelog**: Read [here](https://github.com/lnwu/opencode-statusline-plugins/blob/opencode-kimi-code-statusline%401.1.1/packages/opencode-kimi-code-statusline/CHANGELOG.md)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lnwu/opencode-statusline-plugins/compare/opencode-kimi-code-statusline%401.1.0...opencode-kimi-code-statusline%401.1.1

releases.name: opencode-kimi-code-statusline 1.1.0
releases.body:
### Changed

- Adapt the statusline to the terminal width: full labels and reset countdowns at 120+ columns, short labels (`5H`, `W`) at 80–119, the weekly window only below 80; expanding the footer details no longer forces the countdowns.

<details>
<summary>简体中文</summary>

### 变更

- 按终端宽度调整状态栏：≥ 120 列显示完整标签和重置倒计时，80–119 列使用短标签（`5H`、`W`），< 80 列只显示每周窗口；展开底栏详情不再强制显示倒计时。

</details>

**Changelog**: Read [here](https://github.com/lnwu/opencode-statusline-plugins/blob/opencode-kimi-code-statusline%401.1.0/packages/opencode-kimi-code-statusline/CHANGELOG.md)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lnwu/opencode-statusline-plugins/compare/opencode-kimi-code-statusline%401.0.1...opencode-kimi-code-statusline%401.1.0
